tagline: Leader in tax-advantaged health savings account administration and consumer-directed benefits
hero_kpi_rationale: The HSA Assets KPI is the Hero because it represents the company's core business and its leading position in health savings account management. With $36.5 billion in assets under management as of January 31, 2026, it is the key metric reflecting growth in the tax-advantaged healthcare services market and market share capture (20% of the HSA market measured by assets).

kpis.name: HSA Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed in Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
kpis.description: HSA assets represent the company's primary business. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the past 5 years.

kpis.name: Total Accounts Managed
kpis.explanation: Total number of accounts managed, including HSAs (10.6 million) and complementary Consumer-Directed Benefits (CDB) accounts (7.2 million)
kpis.description: Total accounts represent all accounts managed by the company

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Total balance of cash and cash equivalents available
kpis.description: Cash and cash equivalents represent the company's ability to meet its short-term obligations and fund growth activities
kpis.signal: Strong liquidity for operations and investments

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of €1.31 Bn in the last year

kpis.name: Total Assets

risks.title: Tax Reform
risks.summary: Changes in tax laws could eliminate or reduce the tax advantages of HSAs and CDBs, thereby affecting the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly exposed to changes in the tax benefits of HSAs and CDBs, which could have a significant impact on its business. The language used in the report is very clear about potential risks. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Partner Failure
risks.summary: The failure of a partner, such as an insurance or deposit partner, could negatively impact the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: The failure of a partner could significantly impact the company, including loss of trust and reputation. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Increased competition in the HSA and CDB market could make it more difficult for the company to maintain its market share and revenue.
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the HSA and CDB market is high and competitors have significant resources to develop new products and services. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Decline in Interest Rates
risks.summary: A decline in interest rates could negatively impact the company's revenues and its ability to attract new customers.
risks.score_rationale: A decline in interest rates could reduce the company's revenues and make it more difficult to maintain competitiveness. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology and Data Security Risks
risks.summary: Challenges related to data security and technological continuity could affect customer trust and regulatory compliance.
risks.score_rationale: The company's increasing use of technology creates data security and privacy risks, particularly important in the healthcare context. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Changes in the Healthcare Industry
risks.summary: Changes in the healthcare industry could impact demand for the company's products and services and make it more difficult to maintain market share.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in the healthcare industry could affect demand for the company's products and services. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Loss of Customer Trust
risks.summary: Loss of customer trust could negatively impact the company's business and its ability to maintain market share.
risks.score_rationale: Loss of customer trust could significantly impact the company's business and its ability to maintain market share. (default score, to be refined)
